items.title: Tesla Stock Drops as It Seeks to Tap Massive Self-Driving Market
items.summary: Tesla  stock fell modestly on Thursday as the electric vehicle maker continues to work toward European approval for its Full Self-Driving driver-assistance product, which could unlock a new stream of earnings.  The move came after Reuters reported that the Netherlands is keeping secret the data it used to approve FSD in the country, which could pose an issue for wider adoption in the European Union.  FSD is Tesla’s highest-level driver assistance product that can do most of the driving most of the time.

items.title: Chinese Robot Maker To IPO At $9 Billion Valuation. How It Compares To Tesla's Optimus.
items.summary: Humanoid robot developer Unitree announced it will price its upcoming IPO at $22.34 a share, giving it a valuation of $9 billion.  The deal will make Unitree China's first public humanoid robot company.  Unitree's IPO comes at a time when investors are becoming increasingly focused on the prospect of AI-enabled robotics.
